cds.title: Stetson University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (PDF; a 2025-26 edition was not found)

ipeds.title: IPEDS via NCES College Navigator - Stetson University (student-to-faculty ratio)

stats.notes: Fall 2024 first-year class (CDS C1). International applicants 2,576 and admits 974 (38% vs 72% overall; 83% in-state, 76% out-of-state), so international admission is much more selective than the overall rate suggests. Undergrad enrollment and intl count are B1/B2 totals (2,349; nonresident 211). Test scores are optional: only 38% of enrolled students submitted SAT and 18% ACT, so the percentiles describe a self-selected group. C11 distribution is for all enrolled students.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (Fall 2026): SAT/ACT 'not required for admission, but considered if submitted'.

cost.notes: CDS G1/G5 (2025-26, first-year): tuition $59,290, required fees $400, on-campus housing $9,741 plus food $8,601; books $850, other $1,099. Stetson says an F-1 applicant must show funds for one year of tuition and fees plus about $4,200 for books and other expenses. H6: non-need-based institutional aid is available to nonresidents and 197 received it; the CDS-reported average of $61,173 exceeds tuition, so it is not recorded here.
